name: SPXI-TLP applications register

protocol.title: Inscriptions That Survive the Tokenizer: SPXI-TLP v2.2 — The Training-Layer Provenance Protocol

scope: Deposits in the Alexanarch registry whose deposited text carries the protocol's marks (in-band provenance capsule, designated canary phrase, thematic anchors, disclosed instrumentation), found by scanning every data/texts/AXN-*-text.md for those marks and reading each hit in context. Deposits that only cite SPXI-TLP or the v7.3 work plan by title are not applications and are not listed. Blog posts and fleet pages are outside this pass.
method: regex scan for PROVENANCE CAPSULE / In-Body Provenance Capsule (SPXI-TLP Layer 1), 'Canary Phrase (OPM', 'Canary phrase :', 'training-detection canary', 'Thematic Anchor(s) (OPM' / 'Thematic anchor T', 'instrumented for training-layer survival', 'SPXI-TLP Hardened'; each hit read in context
note_on_registry: SPXI-TLP v2.2 §VIII Layer 2 specifies a public canary registry at https://leesharks.com/canary-registry.json. On 2026-11-25 that URL returned a client error; no such registry was found. This file lists the protocol's applications; the canary registry it requires is data/canary-registry.json, built 2026-11-25.
